name: Sea Buckthorn Preserve
description: Small-batch preserve made from wild sea-buckthorn berries hand-picked at 2,700m in Gilgit-Baltistan. Tart, vitamin-C-rich, and cooked in small batches within hours of harvest.
key_features: 100% natural — zero preservatives, zero artificial colour
Wild-harvested sea-buckthorn, unavailable in commercial production
Small-batch production — max 200 jars per batch
benefits: A tart, distinctive flavour unlike any commercial jam
Naturally high in vitamin C — a healthier gifting choice
A meaningful gift — every jar tells the story of GB
Supports local GB farming families directly
pricing_details: PKR 950 per 250g jar, PKR 2,200 for a gift box of 3
unique_selling_points: The only Pakistani preserve brand sourcing wild sea-buckthorn from Gilgit-Baltistan
Distinct tart flavour profile unavailable anywhere outside GB
Every batch is traceable to a named farm in Ghizer
target_use_case: Daily breakfast table, gifting for Eid and weddings, health-conscious buyers
